name: singlet_statistics_multiple_testing_control
title: Multiple-testing (FDR) control across genes and groups
description: Adjusts per-gene, per-group p-values for multiple testing and returns q-values and reject flags at a stated FDR level. The caller must declare the family (pooled across groups or per group) and may choose BH (default), BY, Bonferroni, Storey q-value or IHW. Requires valid per-test p-values in varm/<test>_pvalues; do not use it on cell-level p-values from pseudoreplicated tests, or on clusters defined from the same counts without post-clustering correction. Writes varm/<test>_qvalues, varm/<test>_reject and uns/<test>_fdr.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

test.description: Name of the test whose genes-by-groups p-values sit in varm/<test>_pvalues.

family.description: FDR family: all gene-group tests together, or each group separately. Required; there is no default.

method.description: Adjustment procedure. Use bh unless dependence or informative covariates justify by or ihw.

alpha.description: Nominal FDR level for reject flags. Adjusted values do not depend on it.

missing.description: NaN tests: exclude removes them from family size m; set_to_one keeps them as p = 1.

qvalue.description: Options for method qvalue: Storey pi0 estimation and q-values.

lambda_min.description: Lowest lambda in the pi0 grid.

lambda_max.description: Highest lambda in the pi0 grid; must exceed lambda_min.

lambda_step.description: Spacing of the pi0 lambda grid.

smooth_df.description: Degrees of freedom of the smoothing spline for pi0 over lambda.

pi0_small_m.description: Below this many tests pi0 is fixed at 1, following SpatialDE.

pfdr.description: Use the positive-FDR variant with finite-m correction.

ihw.description: Options for method ihw: covariates must be independent of null p-values.

covariates.description: Per-test covariates; each must exist as varm/<test>_<covariate>.

nfolds.description: Cross-fitting folds for weight estimation, assigned deterministically by test index.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/<test>_qvalues. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: family, method, alpha, m_tests, n_nan, rejections (total and by_group), pi0 per family for qvalue.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
